statusReason: The control asset library and the functional inventory are final. Control bounds are pending the four full-screen setup plates and the training bar, which set the registration every hit region must match. SCREEN_DESIGN_WORKFLOW.md phase 2 allows a draft contract ahead of final artwork; every entry whose bounds are not yet derivable carries boundsStatus 'pending-layout-plate' rather than an invented rectangle.
coordinateRule: Every full-screen layer, moving control asset, dynamic text region and hit region shares one design-to-screen transform. The app fits the 1536x1024 frame with ArtworkScreen/ArtworkGeometry and expresses all bounds as fractions of that fitted frame, so no layer scales independently. Control assets are placed by their own design-coordinate rectangle within the same frame.

layers.note: The room. Preserved across both states; training reveals more of it.
Reusable console frame, shared with other setup screens.
Ear-training-specific interior. Establishes where every control sits.
Static housings. A housing that never moves stays baked here.
Illuminated/selected treatments, drawn above the faces and gated by state.
Individual PNGs under controls/, positioned and animated per control. Never the master sheet.
Compact bar that replaces the whole setup console once an exercise starts.
Live Compose text. Nothing in this list is ever baked into artwork.
Compose hit regions, at least the minimum touch target even where the drawn control is smaller.

controls.note: The four authored ear families. Labels are EarTaskFamily.label, rendered as Compose text; nothing is baked.
07 §5 counts replays as assistance evidence, so the count is displayed and the control disables when the rule is spent.
Green when receiving, amber when a keyboard is available but not connected, off when there is none.
The setup→training transition needs an explicit commit control; the engine itself starts a session as soon as a family is chosen.

dynamicText.note: Revealed only after an answer: naming it is half of what identify-then-play tests.

notLoadBearing.note: Assets in the library that this screen does not use. Listed so a future pass does not read their presence as a missing feature — STEP 5: the package is a component library, not a specification.
notLoadBearing.reason: Tempo, range, instrument choice, inversion pools and direction are read from the authored ExercisePolicy today and are not player-adjustable. Adding a knob for them would be inventing a feature the engine does not have.

runtimeRules: Do not render source/moving_parts_master.png. It is the cutting sheet.
Do not bake note names into artwork. note_button_*_blank.png carries the face; the pitch is Compose text, spelled from application state.
Do not bake exercise number, verdict, accuracy, counts, chord symbols or MIDI state into artwork.
A control housing that never moves belongs in control_faces; only independently animated or state-swapped pieces get a runtime asset.
Rotate one knob asset around its centre rather than shipping an image per angle.
Sliders keep a static rail; only the thumb moves.
The setup console is not visible during training — the compact bar replaces it, and the room is preserved.
Touch targets meet the minimum size even where the drawn control is smaller.

engineContract.note: Presentation is replaceable; this contract is not. Touch and MIDI both resolve to the same StateFlow, so artwork state can never drift from the exercise engine.
engineContract.notPersisted: Ear attempts are not written to the attempt store yet — AttemptRecord is built around ExerciseInstance, which EarExercise has no equivalent of. Mastery and gate completion are unaffected by an ear session.
